executive_summary: Convolutional neural networks are used in computer vision and convolutional networks are based on tensors. Zero-padding adds a border of zeros around the input perimeter so convolutional filters can process edge pixels without shrinking spatial resolution prematurely. Convolutional output dimensions and receptive field growth in real-time computer vision are studied. A convolutional backbone is used to train pixel-wise segmentation models.
